content.summary: Defense contractor L3Harris Technologies struck a deal to sell a controlling interest in a business that makes engines that power spacecraft. Private equity firm AE Industrial Partners will acquire a roughly 60% stake in the Aerojet Rocketdyne product lines, including the RL-10 engines used on part of United Launch Alliance’s Vulcan Centaur rocket.
